A '''captain''' served aboard the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] circa [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. He reported to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] that a device on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shalyvane]] had [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destructed]], meaning that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had fallen into a trap set by Vader. Vader then ordered the captain to set course for [[Krake's Planet]], where the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] hoped to capture his son.

==Behind the scenes==
Given the proximity of the sources ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'' and [[Star Wars (1977) 63|''Star Wars'' (1977) 63]] in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|timeline]], it would perhaps seem plausible that this character is Captain [[Kallic]], who assumes command of the ''Executor'' while Darth Vader is recalled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] following his [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|encounter]] with Luke Skywalker on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. However, no source connects these two characters in any way.
